quote: To celebrate a festival means: to live out, for some special occasion and in an uncommon manner, the universal assent to the world as a whole.
source: Josef Pieper, In Tune with the World: A Theory of Festivity, p. 23 (trans. Richard and Clara Winston, 1965)
note: Corrected the page. The wording is confirmed in the 1965 Harcourt printing, but p. 30 belongs to the 1999 St. Augustine's Press reprint. Two independent citations of the 1965 and 1973 printings give p. 23; that page was not seen directly.
